name: nextjs-development
description: Implement and optimize features using the repository's Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind stack.
---

# Next.js Development Skill

- Inspect current App Router structure and conventions before coding.
- Prefer Server Components; add client boundaries only for browser interaction.
- Keep data fetching close to the route and handle loading/error/empty states.
- Use typed props and narrow, explicit data contracts.
- Optimize images, fonts, metadata and bundle size using existing framework capabilities.
- For Leaflet, isolate browser-dependent code and provide graceful fallbacks.
- Run npm run lint and npm run build when practical; run a type check if configured.
- Explain dependency changes and avoid paid services.
